jobs.title: Accounting Analytics & BI Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you'll play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial AI by establishing the analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities our Accounting organization runs on. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with the Accounting organization to build the data foundation that turns financial and operational data into reliable, self-serve insight and automated processes. That means owning the data models and orchestration beneath accounting analytics, designing the dashboards and data applications stakeholders rely on day to day, and partnering across Data Engineering, Data Science, and the broader Finance organization to make sure every number is one the team can trust. Increasingly, it also means defining the future of AI-powered accounting automation; finding where AI can take on work that is manual today and reshape how the function operates.</p> <p>This is a foundational, hands-on role at the intersection of accounting, analytics, and business intelligence. You'll establish the durable, scalable systems the fast-growing function depends on, bringing the rigor of a culture of excellence to a function still being built from the ground up, and taking projects end to end, from an ambiguous question to a trusted, scalable system.</p> <h2><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain data models and orchestration pipelines (dbt, Airflow) that power analytics, reporting, and downstream financial workflows</li> <li>Develop dashboards, visualizations, and data applications that give stakeholders self-serve access to their data</li> <li>Translate stakeholders' business questions into well-defined metrics and tools, and turn the resulting analysis into clear recommendations</li> <li>Build analytics that support financial reporting, the close process, reconciliations, and scenario analysis</li> <li>Define the future of AI-powered accounting automation in partnership with stakeholders, streamlining workflows and reducing manual effort</li> <li>Champion data quality, testing, and documentation across the data stack</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Minimum qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Python (or another object-oriented programming language)</li> <li>Experience with data modeling and orchestration tools (e.g., dbt and Airflow)</li> <li>Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, Streamlit)</li> <li>Experience designing self-serve analytics experiences for non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>A track record of partnering closely with Finance or Accounting teams to drive business and financial outcomes, turning open questions and data into clear, insightful analysis</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience using AI to improve or automate analytical processes</li> <li>Experience building data applications</li> <li>Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and their cost structures</li> <li>Experience modeling financial impact, including forecasting and scenario analysis</li> <li>A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of effective</li> <li>A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress</li> <li>A deep curiosity and energy for pulling the thread on hard questions</li> <li>A passion for Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$220,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$270,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from&nbsp;@anthropic.com&nbsp;email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div>

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Join a fully remote opportunity where you’ll help shape data-driven reporting, streamline workflows, and support internal teams with reliable access to actionable insights. This role blends hands-on data engineering with dashboard development, offering the chance to work across modern data platforms, automation tools, and cloud technologies in a collaborative environment. Responsibilities Build, maintain, and improve data structures and pipelines aligned with business needs. Support reporting and analytics solutions through dashboard development and data visualization. Work with data lakes, data warehouses, and Databricks environments to organize and govern data. Develop ETL processes and assist with data pipeline troubleshooting and optimization. Create and support dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools. Design workflow automations, including Microsoft Power Automate, to improve efficiency. Translate business requirements into technical solutions and clear data flows. Help analysts and internal stakeholders access, understand, and use data effectively. Contribute to reporting, data quality, and monitoring efforts to support accurate insights. Collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver end-to-end solutions. Skills Strong background in data engineering and pipeline development. Hands-on experience with Databricks workspace and dataset management. Experience with PySpark and Spark SQL for ETL and data transformation work. Dashboard development experience using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Working knowledge of data lakes, data warehouses, and data governance concepts. Experience automating workflows, preferably with Microsoft Power Automate. Exposure to cloud environments, especially AWS services such as S3, EC2, Lambda, IAM, VPC networking, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and KMS. Understanding of IT operations, DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure concepts. Familiarity with security and compliance practices, including vulnerability management. Ability to analyze data and present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Skills Experience working in a federal, regulated, or highly secure environment. Knowledge of Azure concepts. Background in data analytics, reporting, or business intelligence support. Experience building self-service reporting solutions for internal users. Familiarity with automation for customer communications or backend processes. Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, team-oriented setting. Horizontal is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds feel respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion as essential to building strong teams and better solutions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and agree that Horizontal Talent may contact you regarding your application using automated technology, including phone calls, SMS/text messages, or email, which may be delivered by our virtual AI recruiter, Alex. Please apply through this online posting or by visiting our Job Board at www.horizontaltalent.com/job-board. Applications will be accepted for 4 weeks. For those that join the team, we offer competitive compensation and benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement. Check out all we have to offer and how you can become part of the Horizontal Talent Team. The pay range for this role is $50 - $87 per hour based on qualifications and experience.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: HCLTech is looking for a highly talented and self- motivated Data Scientist to join it in advancing the technological world through innovation and creativity. Job Title: Data Scientist Job REQ ID: 123736 Position Type: Full Time Location: Austin TX Responsibilities Engineer enhancements and improvements of internal tooling by analyzing data and generating statistical information to identify trends and patterns Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate data-driven solutions into software applications and support workflow processes . Present actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders through reports and dashboards 1) Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python or R for scripting and data manipulation; SQL for querying databases. 2) Statistics & Mathematics: Deep understanding of probability, statistical distributions, hypothesis testing, and linear algebra. 3) Machine Learning & AI: Experience with frameworks like scikit-learn , TensorFlow , or PyTorch to build predictive models. 4) Data Visualization: Ability to present data clearly using tools like Tableau , Power BI , Matplotlib , or Seaborn . 5) Data Wrangling: Techniques to clean, process, and structure messy "raw" data Pay and Benefits Pay Range Minimum: $79000/annum Pay Range Maximum: $121000/annum HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, physical disability or genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state, and/or local law. Should any applicant have concerns about discrimination in the hiring process, they should provide a detailed report of those concerns to secure@hcltech.com for investigation. A candidate’s pay within the range will depend on their skills, experience, education, and other factors permitted by law. This role may also be eligible for performance-based bonuses subject to company policies. In addition, this role is eligible for the following benefits subject to company policies: medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, life, accidental death & dismemberment, and disability insurance; employee assistance program; 401(k) retirement plan; 10 days of paid time off per year (some positions are eligible for need-based leave with no designated number of leave days per year); and 10 paid holidays per year How You’ll Grow At HCLTech, we offer continuous opportunities for you to find your spark and grow with us. We want you to be happy and satisfied with your role and to really learn what type of work sparks your brilliance the best. Throughout your time with us, we offer transparent communication with senior-level employees, learning and career development programs at every level, and opportunities to experiment in different roles or even pivot industries. We believe that you should be in control of your career with unlimited opportunities to find the role that fits you best you best
